title: Communion of Saints
definition: The Communion of Saints is the shared fellowship, mutual care, and spiritual participation believers have in Christ.
summary: Communion of Saints is the shared life, fellowship, and mutual participation believers have in Christ.
christFocus: Jesus Christ unites His people into a fellowship of grace, love, prayer, and service.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: This doctrine focuses on spiritual fellowship created by union with Christ. Believers share joys, burdens, resources, prayers, worship, suffering, and hope because they belong to the same Lord. Communion is deeper than social friendliness; it is Gospel fellowship with spiritual responsibility.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because loneliness can exist even in crowded churches when fellowship remains shallow. The communion of saints calls believers into mutual care, confession, encouragement, generosity, and perseverance. It helps the Church become a real community of grace.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Move beyond surface conversation where trust allows. Share burdens and carry the burdens of others. Practice fellowship around Christ, Scripture, prayer, and faithful presence.
